subject.title: feat(discord/voice): add sessionChannelId to autoJoin for text-channel transcript routing

question: Should Discord voice text routing be implemented by extending the existing `voice.agentSession` target surface, by adding per-autoJoin `sessionChannelId`, or by reopening the broader voice-as-I/O design?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent fix changes public Discord voice config and message-delivery semantics and overlaps a documented existing route surface.

options.title: Extend voice.agentSession
options.body: Use the existing voice-level target route as the canonical session selector and add explicit text transcript/reply mirroring semantics there if maintainers want visible Discord text output.

options.title: Accept per-autoJoin target
options.body: Review or replace the linked fork PR around `autoJoin.sessionChannelId`, including validation, docs, delivery behavior, and live proof.

options.title: Reopen broader bridge design
options.body: Treat this narrow request as a satellite and first settle the broader voice-as-I/O semantics for attribution, target selection, and tool access.

recommendation.title: Extend voice.agentSession
recommendation.body: Use the existing voice-level target route as the canonical session selector and add explicit text transcript/reply mirroring semantics there if maintainers want visible Discord text output.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the clearest recent history on the affected Discord voice routing and issue-review boundary.
